name: Abe no Takahisa
source:
The past self of the protagonist in the Heian period. A struggling onmyoji who, despite his training, shows no signs of progress and has recently devoted himself almost entirely to swordsmanship. He finds himself strongly drawn to a woman named Hotaru, whom he meets by chance.

[Translated from [url=https://www.xuse.co.jp/product/048_kuon-s/]link[/url]]
